definitions.gloss: to fall completely silent; to become dead quiet
definitions.explanation: Describes a place or group of people becoming utterly still and silent. Stronger and more emphatic than 静まる alone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}った。
⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The residential neighborhood was dead quiet late at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壇上|だんじょう}→壇上：21719_danjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: The moment the principal took the stage, the gymnasium fell instantly silent.

notes:
{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}る is an intransitive godan verb. It is a compound of ⟦{静|しず}まる→静まる：04580_shizumaru⟧ (to become quiet) and ⟦{返|かえ}る→返る：29164_kaeru⟧ used as a suffix meaning "thoroughly" or "completely."

ASPECT (ている):
{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes a state of complete silence already achieved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}る (classroom falls silent)
- ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}る (venue falls silent)
- ⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}る (the surroundings go quiet)

The ～⟦{返|かえ}る→返る：29164_kaeru⟧ suffix intensifies the base verb, similar to how {冷|ひ}え{返|かえ}る means "to become ice cold."
